steps.en: Once OIC rejects, the request status becomes Rejected by itself
steps.id: Begitu OIC menolak, status request otomatis jadi Rejected

steps.en: The rejecting OIC's user ID is stored with the request
steps.id: User ID OIC yang menolak ikut tersimpan pada request

steps.en: Rejected status and OIC user ID are visible when browsing
steps.id: Status Rejected dan user ID OIC terlihat saat browsing
steps.why_en: The screen that shows these fields is hidden once a request is approved or rejected.
steps.why_id: Layar yang menampilkan field ini disembunyikan setelah request disetujui atau ditolak.
